Phrase 6 (1:11.6) introduces Ek, centred on B. Phrase 14 (3:33.9) introduces Gs, centred on F#. Phrase 15 (3:47.4) introduces A, centred on F#. Phrase 16 (4:07.8) introduces Bk, centred on F#. Phrase 17 (4:17.9) introduces Ak, centred on F#. The line peaks at C#5 (558.0 Hz) at 2:46.8. It closes on C#4, not the tonic (Ds4 → E4 → Ek4 → D#4 → C#4 → C#4).
